title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（徳永光晴研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Tokunaga Mitsuharu)
educationalGoal: Students complete the project design III report by consciously and practicing KIT IDEALS, a learning education goal in the Department of Environmental Civil Engineering. Achieve educational goals in specialized areas, which are the culmination of courses related to spatial information engineering.
advice: Tokunaga Laboratory will carry out projects related to spatial information engineering. Participate in various events such as regional cooperation, KIT spatial information project, G space & ICT, etc., to deepen understanding of spatial information engineering. The research theme is advanced research themes based on the premise of going on to graduate school and research themes based on undergraduate graduation, and projects are carried out by students thinking and acting on their own. At the beginning of the project, students learn how to use the equipment and software necessary to carry out the project. If necessary, review the projects developed by the specialized seminar. Specific themes are determined by the needs of society, such as joint research with companies, and projects are carried out by individuals or groups. Basically, we hold project progress reports and liaison meetings every week, and hold presentations once a month. In the KIT Spatial Information Project, each project will be presented in front of the participants of the company. It is positioned as an interim report meeting. It is recommended that you need at least 360 hours of study and ensure that you have about 450 hours of study time. Think of the minimum necessary time for preparation and review of the learning tasks shown in the study support plan.
requiredKnowledge: Review the contents of lectures such as Surveyology I, II, Survey Practice and Exercise I, II, Spatial Information Engineering, Environmental Civil Engineering Experiments and Exercise B. Also, organize the textbooks and materials used in these lectures.

achievementLevels.ideal: After acquiring basic knowledge of GIS, we can explain the application field of GIS in detail, and can perform advanced operation of GIS software. In addition, it is also necessary to assemble a program. After acquiring basic knowledge of CG, students can explain the application field of CG in detail, and can create advanced works by CG. After acquiring basic knowledge of CAD, students can explain the application field of CAD in detail, and can create advanced works by CAD. After acquiring basic knowledge of remote sensing (R/S), it is possible to explain in detail the application field, and it is possible to superimpose various maps using GIS software.
achievementLevels.standard:
Students can acquire basic knowledge of geographic information systems (GIS) and explain the concept of GIS, and can operate GIS software. Students can acquire basic knowledge of computer graphics (CG) and create works.
Students can acquire basic knowledge of CAD and create works. Students can acquire basic knowledge of remote sensing (R/S) and explain the concept of R/S. It can be outlined the application field by the collaboration of the above three technologies.

Specific themes are determined by the needs of society, such as joint research with companies, and projects are carried out by individuals or groups. Basically, we hold project progress reports and liaison meetings every week, and hold presentations once a month.
